validation_scope: Generated repair; behavioral validation not run
summary: The bad() entry point reads the HTTP request parameter "name" and passes it directly to Connection.setCatalog(), letting an external client steer the connection to any catalog it names (CWE-15, external control of a configuration setting). The fix constrains the externally supplied value to an application-approved allowlist of catalog names before using it: a request that names an approved catalog still switches to it (the feature is preserved for valid inputs), but a request can no longer drive the setting to an arbitrary catalog. Null is also handled so the lookup is safe. No tests, build settings, scanner suppressions, or CWE comments are touched.
